observable_law.input: (canonical finite CNF of signed exact nonzero integer literals, canonical sorted consistent assumptions)
observable_law.output: CONTRADICTION(forced) or QUIESCENT(forced,all_satisfied); QUIESCENT never means SAT
observable_law.behavior: For a finite canonical CNF, repeatedly add literals forced by clauses with exactly one not-yet-false literal until no new literal is forced or a clause is falsified. The resulting exact forced literals and explicit contradiction/quiescent status are order-independent for nonconflicting assumptions. Reject malformed/tautological/noncanonical clauses. Do not branch or claim SAT on an undecided fixed point.
witnesses: CNF [[1],[-1,2],[-2,3]] with no assumptions -> QUIESCENT forced [1,2,3], all_satisfied=true
CNF [[-2,1],[1,3]] with assumption [2] -> QUIESCENT forced [1,2], all_satisfied=true
CNF [[-2,-1],[-2,1],[2,-1],[1,2]] with no units -> QUIESCENT with no forced literals, all_satisfied=false; no unjustified SAT conclusion
falsifiers: Report SAT for unit-free but unsatisfiable CNF
Conflate host SAT solver internals with D10 identity
Silently accept bool, zero literal, duplicate, unsorted or tautological CNF
